text: Transgender and gender-expansive people experience high rates of depression, anxiety, and trauma-related distress, yet few evidence-based interventions are tailored to their needs. Kindred is a novel, group-based ketamine-assisted psychotherapy (KAP) program that integrates cognitive processing therapy (CPT) to address identity-based trauma.
source_label: Ketamine-assisted group psychotherapy integrating cognitive processing therapy to address identity-based trauma: a pilot study
